s3-hidden-cmdi.base: CMDI must behave as specified when driven through its entry point CMDI_AppMain with software bus messages, a ValTable image and UDP datagrams on its port, using only the names, structures, message IDs, function codes and event IDs in the specification.

cases.Startup and housekeeping: at initialization CMDI registers ValTable (92 bytes, with a validation function), subscribes to CMDI_CMD_MID, CMDI_SEND_HK_MID and CMDI_WAKEUP_MID, binds UDP port 1234 + node ID - 1 and emits CMDI_INIT_INF_EID once; SEND_HK sends CMDI_HkTlm_t in the specified field order with EnableMask and MaxAgeSeconds from the table; NOOP emits CMDI_NOOP_INF_EID and increments CommandCounter
cases.Port per node: CMDI binds UDP port 1234 + node ID - 1 (1235 on node 2) and executes valid frames received there
cases.Socket error: a socket that cannot be bound is reported with CMDI_SOCKET_ERR_EID (ERROR type) and CMDI keeps running, answering housekeeping requests and sending its heartbeat
cases.Startup error events: table registration, table load and software bus read failures are reported with CMDI_TBL_REG_ERR_EID, CMDI_TBL_LOAD_ERR_EID and CMDI_PIPE_ERR_EID
cases.Valid frame: each datagram is validated with CMDVAL_ValidateFrame using the active configuration and the current onboard seconds; a valid frame's embedded command is sent unchanged with CFE_SB_TransmitMsg(..., false), FramesReceived and FramesAccepted count it, and CMDI_ACCEPT_DBG_EID (DEBUG type) names its MID as 0x%04X
cases.Rejection reasons: frames with a bad CRC, a bad MAC, both (a CRC rejection), an unlisted source, a time more than MaxAgeSeconds before or after the onboard time, a malformed header, an unframed packet and a datagram longer than 1074 bytes are rejected: nothing is sent, the reason's counter rises, and one CMDI_REJECT_ERR_EID (ERROR type) names FORMAT, CRC, HMAC, SOURCE or AGE and, except for FORMAT, the source ID in decimal; a frame exactly MaxAgeSeconds old or ahead is accepted
cases.Rejection statuses: every CMDVAL_ValidateFrame status (FORMAT, CRC, HMAC, SOURCE, AGE) is counted under its own housekeeping counter and named in CMDI_REJECT_ERR_EID, with the frame's SourceId except for FORMAT
cases.Reads per wakeup: every WAKEUP reads up to 16 pending datagrams without blocking, and datagrams beyond 16 wait for the next WAKEUP
cases.Heartbeat: every 10th WAKEUP sends one SFI_HeartbeatCmd_t (function code 0) on SFI_HEARTBEAT_MID with AppName CMDI and Sequence 1 for the first heartbeat, +1 per heartbeat
cases.Set max age: SET_MAX_AGE accepts 1..86400 (CMDI_SET_PARAM_INF_EID, MaxAgeSeconds in housekeeping, the wider window applied to later frames) and rejects 0 and 86401 with CMDI_SET_PARAM_ERR_EID and a command error, changing nothing
cases.Set enable mask: SET_ENABLE_MASK accepts 0..0x0F (CMDI_SET_PARAM_INF_EID) and rejects larger masks with CMDI_SET_PARAM_ERR_EID and a command error, changing nothing; a check whose EnableMask bit is clear is skipped, and with mask 0 only the FORMAT checks remain
cases.Framed parameter commands: SET_ENABLE_MASK and SET_MAX_AGE arriving in valid frames take effect from the next frame, while the same commands sent unframed or in a frame with a bad MAC are rejected and change nothing
cases.Table load overrides: an update of ValTable replaces the key, the allowed sources, MaxAgeSeconds and EnableMask, overriding values set by SET_MAX_AGE and SET_ENABLE_MASK, and later frames are validated against the new table
cases.Table validation: ValTable validation rejects an all-zero key, MaxAgeSeconds 0 or above 86400, EnableMask bits above 0x0F, the SOURCE bit with no nonzero source and duplicate nonzero sources, each with CMDI_TBL_VAL_ERR_EID, and accepts the boundary values
cases.Commands and counters: an unknown function code (CMDI_CC_ERR_EID), a wrong command length (CMDI_CMD_LEN_ERR_EID) and a message with an unexpected MID (CMDI_MID_ERR_EID) are each counted once in CommandErrorCounter and change nothing else, every accepted command increments CommandCounter, and RESET_COUNTERS (CMDI_RESET_INF_EID) zeroes the command counters, FramesReceived, FramesAccepted and the five reason counters but not MaxAgeSeconds or EnableMask
cases.Replay boundaries and wrap: S3.6 replay accepts first0, unseen63-behind, jumps>=64 and FFFFFFFF->0, rejects duplicates,64-behind and exactly2^31, independent per source with exact counters/events.
cases.Replay lifetime and early failures: S3.6 no earlier FORMAT/CRC/HMAC/SOURCE/AGE failure consumes a serial or slot; RESET retains bitmap, an app-rejected command consumes it, table activation clears it.
cases.Runtime source slots: S3.6 SOURCE-disabled ingress still rejects source0 and ninth runtime source without evicting any of eight slots; earlier validation never allocates.
cases.NEXT key validation: S3.3 NEXT boolean/all-zero/equal/NextValid0 constraints are checked on native ValTable validation.
cases.Key switch authentication and shared sta: S3.6 ACTIVE-only validation, mandatory SWITCH_KEY HMAC even mask-disabled before replay, SWITCH_KEY retains window/consumes serial, CFE_TBL_Modified updates shared ACTIVE/NEXT and never leaks key material.
cases.Nine-row source statistics: S3.6 exactly one per-datagram source/reason counter in table order or OTHER, short FORMAT and readable listed FORMAT mapping, repeated SOURCE/replay failures, nine full rows and RESET semantics.
cases.Same-wakeup self-command ordering: S3.6 before one wakeup queue SWITCH_KEY/retired/fresh then mask/age vectors, require immediate dispatch before reading each next UDP datagram.
